What it does: Climb with Space, descend with Ctrl. Aim at a ladder's top or bottom half and press Q to extend the stack that way.
Trampoline. Launches anything that lands on it - friend or foe.
Plank road, laid into the floor you aim at. Rats run 60% faster on it, even hauling cheese.
Laid into the floor you aim at. Runs toward the bright edge of your target square.

Q throws it; it sticks to whatever it hits - ground, wall or rat - and a moment later bursts, throwing everyone near it away (you too), with loose cheese, dynamite and wind-ups. It damages nothing and nobody drops cheese. Ctrl+Q drops it at your feet: launch yourself.
Sideways bumper block. Shoves away any rat that comes within a block of it, and flings back dynamite that runs into it.

A one-way pair of pads. Q puts down the entrance, then Q again the exit. Your team stands on the entrance for half a second and pops out at the exit; then it recharges for 6 s. Cheese can't go through. One set per rat: dig a pad of yours to pick it up and move it; if one gets broken, buying tops you up for half price.
A block in team colours: solid floor or wall for your team, thin air for enemies (and nothing they can dig). TNT blows it up. Dig it to take it back.
Place it anywhere outside the bases. Your team deposits and takes scrap, dirt, stone, ice and obsidian here (or at base) with B. Only 5 TNT blasts break it - and the shared pool survives.
See-through door. Your team walks through. Two TNT blasts (or ten wrecking-ball hits) break it; cracks show the damage.
Slippery block. Slot 3, place with right mouse.
Snaps on enemy rats: short stun and they drop a cheese.
Hit it to light a 2 s fuse. Blows up Team Blocks and cracks Team Gates (two blasts break one). Saboteurs detonate remotely. Chains.
Bouncy dynamite stick, 3 s fuse: a TNT blast wherever it ends up, Team Blocks and Gates included. Q throws it, Ctrl+Q sets it down gently. Springs launch it, conveyors carry it, ice lets it slide.
Glue pad. Enemy rats wade through at half speed; rolling dynamite stops dead.
Fake turf. Solid for your team, a hole for everyone and everything else.
Looks exactly like Golden Cheese - even its name, to the other team. An enemy who digs it gets a face full of stink and is dazed. Single use. Dig your own to take it back.

A clockwork rat in your colours, wearing your name and holding a Golden Cheese high. Q sets it marching the way you face: it hops up steps, turns at walls and drops crumbs like a real carrier. An enemy who bonks it gets a TNT blast. Left alone it goes off after 20 s.
An alarm on the floor: when an enemy steps on it, it squeaks for everyone nearby and drops a beacon your team sees for 8 s. Three squeaks, then it's spent.
T to pilot it, mouse to aim, left mouse to fire (2 scrap a shot). Blasts a 3x3x3 hole - 3 dig hits in the middle - and throws enemies near it.
T to pilot it, mouse to turn, left mouse to pump the swing. The ball smashes through block after block; the faster it swings, the harder it hits.
T to pilot it, A / D to turn it, left mouse to ram the blade: 3 wide, 2 high. Has no engine - feed it conveyors.
Wear it in your gear slot and press J: a burst of thrust lifts you over trenches and up cliffs, half as high while you carry cheese. 5 s to cool down after each burst. One piece of gear at a time.

Press J to switch them on or off. While on, stepping off an edge blows a bubble under your feet instead of falling: a bridge as you walk, each bubble 2 scrap, popping after 10 s. Jump to drop off on purpose. One piece of gear at a time.

Wear it in your gear slot and press J to raise it for 5 s: bonks and cannonballs bounce off, so nobody knocks the cheese out of your paws. Hauling cheese behind it you move a quarter slower. 8 s to ready it again. One piece of gear at a time.
